title: #77 Studying Theater
prompt: What are the problems and the benefits for high school students of studying plays and other works for theatre that were written centuries ago? Do you agree with it? Use your own experience to discuss it.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Studying old plays helps students learn about history by allowing them to understand the customs and daily life of people in past times.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Studying old plays helps students learn about history by allowing them to understand the customs and daily life of people in past times.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, old plays can be difficult to understand because the language used is often old and hard for modern students.

angles.en: The main advantage of studying old plays is that it helps students learn about history and culture.
